explanation: Measure each city’s net fuel as 20×gallons−distance miles. Choose the city after the smallest prefix sum. Starting at that lowest point prevents any later prefix of the circular traversal from falling below the starting level.
timeComplexity: O(n). One pass examines each city once.
spaceComplexity: O(1). Only a candidate index and constant-many fuel balances are retained.

correctness: Let P be the cumulative net-mile sum before each city and choose its first minimum. Until wraparound, every prefix relative to that minimum is nonnegative. After wraparound the relative sum is totalNet+P[j]−minimum, also nonnegative because totalNet is promised nonnegative. Therefore the returned city completes the tour. Widening before multiplication and avoiding division preserve fractional-gallon travel exactly.
walkthrough: For gallons [1,0,2] and distances [25,10,25], net miles are −5,−10,+15. Prefix sums before cities are 0,−5,−15; the minimum is before city 2. Starting there gives balances 15,10,0 and completes the circuit. JSON arguments are [gallons,distances]. The callable returns a start index; expected true means the wrapper successfully simulated the complete trip from that returned index.
edgeCases: Tank capacity is unlimited and starts empty.
Several starts may be valid; any valid index is accepted.
The test contract supplies a nonempty feasible tour.
